## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: sector breadth above neutral and heavy leadership concentration in Energy (Energy weekly +8.09%), Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Top performers are Energy) — neutral overall with cyclical tilt.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate and Utilities show modest support (Real Estate 1W: +1.81%, Utilities 1W: +1.14%) with select names outperforming.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Industrials lag: DE (1W: -7.81% | 1M: +4.84%) CORRECTION, BA (1W: -8.11% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION. Materials weak on the week and Technology soft: GOOGL (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -1.09%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: OXY (1W: +12.29% | 1M: -4.01%) RECOVERY; PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +11.12% | 1M: -11.30%) RECOVERY; MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy) — cyclical/value tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND; BA (1W: -8.11% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION; DE (1W: -7.81% | 1M: +4.84%) CORRECTION; PANW (1W: -7.62% | 1M: +25.48%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in select Industrials and Tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W momentum: OXY (1W: +12.29% | 1M: -4.01%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.12% | 1M: -11.30%) RECOVERY, MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flag: several large caps (PFE, XOM, MSFT) are 1W positive but 1M negative — watch for a trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed: META (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +15.12%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND are strong, while ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND drag the group — sector showing internal dispersion.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive but uneven: MA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +10.13%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +8.70%) CORRECTION — breadth supportive and earnings-driven sentiment present.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Generally steady with idiosyncratic moves: PFE (1W: +3.20% | 1M: -4.38%) RECOVERY on FDA expansion news, UNH (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND, while some names show short-term fatigue — defensive characteristics intact.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Energy and select Financials given narrow leadership and positive sector returns; reduce exposure to underperforming Tech names showing BELOW TREND (ORCL, INTC). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt while monitoring major-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +15.12%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +8.09%) — monitor commodity-driven continuation. BEARISH: Industrials and Materials (Industrials 1W: -2.42%, Materials 1W: -2.33%) — watch earnings/FX and litigation headlines.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch XOM/XLE-linked breakouts on continued crude strength; NVDA (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND for AI momentum confirmation; ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND as a trigger for broader Tech risk reassessment.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PFE (+80): FDA expands Keytruda-Padcev combo; PFE (1W: +3.20% | 1M: -4.38%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirming the 1W bounce. JPM (+60): record Q2 profit; JPM (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +8.70%) CORRECTION — positive news but price showing short-term pullback. MA (+50): Barclays initiate; MA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +10.13%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming strength.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-55): execution/debt concern; ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned. INTU (-50): negative coverage; INTU (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from recent strength, monitor. IBM (-65): earnings warning (no dual timeframe provided in key view) — sector risk for legacy Tech.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy leadership and mixed breadth. Energy and select Financials showing strength (PSX ABOVE TREND, MPC ABOVE TREND, MA ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major-cap divergences and negative Tech/Oracle sentiment could widen if earnings or export-control headlines persist — watch PFE/ORCL price-news confirmation.
